parsed.rationale: Both `app:WatchXYC` (WXYC/WatchXYC/PlayerPage.swift:190) and `app:iOS` (WXYC/iOS/NowPlayingWidget/Extensions.swift:27) declare an identical `extension SwiftUI.Image` with `shared_field_count: 2` and no differing slots, confirming exact duplication. Neither record carries any restraint marker (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false), so consolidation is appropriate. The extension should be moved to a shared module — ideally a dedicated `Extensions` or `Shared` target that both `app:WatchXYC` and `app:iOS` already depend on, or at minimum into a single canonical file (e.g., a new `WXYC/Shared/Extensions/SwiftUI.Image+Extensions.swift`) and removed from both current locations. If no shared target exists today, the iOS `NowPlayingWidget/Extensions.swift` file is the more natural host given it already aggregates extensions, but the longer-term fix is a proper shared module.
